title: Corporate Wellness Partnership: billing-cycle attribution of a combined late fee
content: Under the Corporate Wellness Partnership, whether one or several billing cycles are currently unpaid on an enrollment, the combined late fee for all of them is recorded as a single late-fee entry filed under the enrollment's most recently billed cycle — the billing cycle of the dues charge with the latest recorded time in that enrollment's billing history. Earlier unpaid cycles remain individually represented only by their own original dues-charge entries, and do not receive a separate late-fee entry of their own.
